ontology.note: Existing ontology alignment; full configuration and port shape contracts remain to be defined. Emits is empty because the terms this widget's provenance asserts are written by src/raster-provenance.ts, while implementation.definition names src/core.ts#TYPES; the release declares what the defining module asserts, which is nothing of its own.

changes.description: GRID3 beside WorldPop (TODO 24; the practitioner, 2026-11-10: "For raster input I thought we included GRID3, GHSL, etc. for population rasters"). Configure… offers a population source: WorldPop for every country, or GRID3's 2025 estimates for the 52 countries of sub-Saharan Africa, one file each, named with its size, licence, citation and limits (top-down, not official statistics, no uncertainty layer). Outside sub-Saharan Africa it says GRID3 publishes nothing. The catalogue is taken by scripts/grid3-catalogue.mjs from the listing and each file's headers.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. 0.6.0: tests/raster-point-registration.test.mjs checks a point grid read as cells around its nodes, and a window keeping each value at its node; EGM2008 read from cdn.proj.org at the Manila gauge gives 43.009 m bilinearly, PROJ's value. 0.7.1: tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs checks the Inspector asks no country, and Configure… offers WorldPop for Botswana from the area, or says to set the country on the area; Chromium. 0.7.2: tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs chooses Botswana in the dialog, finds the download link, and finds the country kept on the study area; Chromium. 0.8.0: tests/area-countries.browser.mjs (two countries offered, the one-file limit said, the area's list left as it was). 0.9.0: tests/grid3-catalogue.test.mjs and tests/country-from-study-area.browser.mjs (GRID3 for Botswana, 11.6 MB; none for Germany).
